mapper.insert: insert into ry_rental.ry_rental_payment_order (tenant_id, member_id, payment_no, biz_type, biz_id, biz_no, subject, amount, payment_status, expire_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, is_delete) values (#{tenantId}, #{memberId}, #{paymentNo}, #{bizType}, #{bizId}, #{bizNo}, #{subject}, #{amount}, #{pendingStatus}, #{expireTime}, #{operatorId}, now(), #{operatorId}, now(), 0)
mapper.select: select payment_id, tenant_id, member_id, payment_no, biz_type, biz_id, biz_no, subject, amount, payment_status, alipay_trade_no, notify_id, paid_time, expire_time from ry_rental.ry_rental_payment_order where payment_no = #{paymentNo} and is_delete = 0 limit 1 for update

select payment_id, tenant_id, member_id, payment_no, biz_type, biz_id, biz_no, subject, amount, payment_status, alipay_trade_no, notify_id, paid_time, expire_time from ry_rental.ry_rental_payment_order where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and member_id = #{memberId} and payment_no = #{paymentNo} and is_delete = 0 limit 1

select payment_id, tenant_id, member_id, payment_no, biz_type, biz_id, biz_no, subject, amount, payment_status, alipay_trade_no, notify_id, paid_time, expire_time from ry_rental.ry_rental_payment_order where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and member_id = #{memberId} and biz_type = #{bizType} and biz_id = #{bizId} and is_delete = 0 order by payment_id desc limit 1 for update
mapper.update: update ry_rental.ry_rental_payment_order set payment_status = #{closedStatus}, update_time = now() where payment_id = #{paymentId} and payment_status = #{unpaidStatus} and is_delete = 0

update ry_rental.ry_rental_payment_order set payment_status = #{paidStatus}, alipay_trade_no = #{alipayTradeNo}, notify_id = #{notifyId}, paid_time = now(), update_time = now() where payment_id = #{paymentId} and payment_status = #{pendingStatus} and is_delete = 0
mapper.insert: insert into ry_rental.ry_rental_finance_ledger (tenant_id, member_id, account_type, ledger_no, direction, biz_type, amount, balance_after, ref_type, ref_id, pay_channel, pay_order_no, ledger_status, create_by, create_time, remark, is_delete) values (#{tenantId}, #{memberId}, #{accountType}, #{ledgerNo}, #{direction}, #{bizType}, #{amount}, #{balanceAfter}, #{refType}, #{refId}, #{payChannel}, #{payOrderNo}, #{ledgerStatus}, #{operatorId}, now(), #{remark}, 0)

insert into ry_rental.ry_rental_finance_account (tenant_id, member_id, account_type, available_amount, frozen_amount, account_status, version, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, is_delete) values (#{tenantId}, #{memberId}, #{accountType}, #{amount}, 0.00, 1, 0, #{operatorId}, now(), #{operatorId}, now(), 0) on duplicate key update available_amount = available_amount + #{amount}, account_status = 1, version = version + 1, update_by = #{operatorId}, update_time = now()
